properties.name: Bahia Coast and Recôncavo Zone
properties.principle: Culture: the Atlantic Forest coast and the Bay of All Saints, the Afro-Brazilian heartland, from the Rio Real to the Espírito Santo line. Its Sectors are Bahia's own Territórios de Identidade, each the union of its municipalities in IBGE's mesh, so their lines are municipal limits (surveyed). The bay's water is where IBGE puts it; the Abrolhos archipelago is a marine part of Extremo Sul drawn here (approximate).

declared.name: Baía de Todos-os-Santos
declared.note: IBGE's municipal mesh already closes the Baía de Todos-os-Santos at its mouths (Farol da Barra to the Itaparica shore; the Canal de Itaparica's southern mouth) and divides its water among the municipalities around it, by their legal limits. Most of it lies in this Sector's municipalities (Salvador, Itaparica, Vera Cruz, Madre de Deus, São Francisco do Conde, Candeias). The western shallows and the Baía do Iguape lie in Recôncavo's (Saubara, Salinas da Margarida, Santo Amaro, Maragogipe, Cachoeira) and part of the Canal de Itaparica in Jaguaripe's (Baixo Sul), and stay there: moving them would mean cutting a shoreline through those Territórios that no surveyed source here draws.

declared.name: Arquipélago dos Abrolhos and the Parcel dos Abrolhos
declared.note: Drawn round the five islands of the Arquipélago dos Abrolhos (Caravelas) and the Parcel dos Abrolhos reefs from GeoNames points, about 40 km offshore; IBGE's single-polygon mesh draws none of the islands. Not the whole Abrolhos Bank, which is the shelf from Prado to Espírito Santo.

properties.character: The Costa dos Coqueiros: a coconut coast of dunes and lagoons from Mangue Seco at the Rio Real, with the agreste hinterland of Alagoinhas behind it.
